definitions: A data structure that maps or links corresponding items between two different systems or datasets.
A reference table used to translate codes, identifiers, or values from one standard or schema to another.
examples: The project requires a crosswalk table to integrate the legacy system with the new database.
We built a crosswalk table to reconcile product IDs across different vendor catalogs.
Ensure the crosswalk table is up-to-date before running the data migration.
